VAT excl. Shipping The Lexar Professional NM1090 PRO 1TB is a high-performance M.2 NVMe SSD designed for systems supporting PCIe 5.0 x4. With sequential read speeds of up to 14,000 MB/s and write speeds of up to 10,000 MB/s, it provides very fast data transfers for demanding applications, gaming and content creation. The drive uses 3D TLC NAND and combines DRAM with dynamic SLC caching for responsive performance under demanding workloads.
